what_i_did: Read lab/TASKS.md, tasks/math/spec.md, tasks/math/dev.json and the number checker in lab/core.py. Wrote 21 single-mode algebra tasks (7 easy, 7 medium, 7 hard), each with a number check on a single integer answer, the spec's verbatim integer format sentence and max_tokens 320.
answer_verification: Every expected answer was computed in Python by a generator script, independently of the written working: brute-force search over integer ranges with exact Fraction arithmetic, asserting a unique solution where the problem has one unknown (max/min/count for the inequality tasks). The script asserts each computed value equals the value put in the check before writing the file.
not_done: No model pilot was run on these tasks (held out). Difficulty labels are estimates from the spec's guidance, not measured. Other generators' files were not read, so cross-generator overlap was not checked.
